set_review.differentiation_evidence: The six complete saved PNGs and 320px exports were inspected individually and compared together. AlphaProof uses a three-stage brass-and-slate checker cutaway, EcoStatKG uses teal and orange parallel benchmark tracks with a mesh filter, Qwen uses a cut-paper access aperture and bounded ribbon, Voice uses separated architectural waveform rails, Business Agents uses a folded proofing folio with independent pockets, and Maya uses a layered cartographic engraving with a prior-map correction path. Exact priority labels and white field hierarchy remain visible across the set.

images.alt_text: Approved specifications guide proof work on compiled routines. A proof checker verifies selected properties under the stated assumptions.

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: Four exact labels remain readable at 320px. The blue arrow begins at the actual specification-sheet edge and points into the circular proof-checker inlet through the compiled-routine section. The detached selected-properties qualification is above the bottom margin. The revised housing has ample white space and the decorative blank plaque is gone.
